newsitem.title: CANADA: PanCanadian to auction oil/gas properties.
newsitem.headline: PanCanadian to auction oil/gas properties.

text.p: PanCanadian Petroleum Ltd said on Thursday it would offer for sale a package of western Canada producing and non producing oil and gas properties.
PanCanadian said the assets were expected to produce 2,400 barrels of oil and gas liquids and 16 million cubic feet of gas per day in 1997.
The properties' proven and probable reserves were pegged at 6.8 million barrels of oil and liquids and 33.6 billion cubic feet of gas, the company said.
It said it retained CIBC Wood Gundy as agent for the sale.
It said about 65 percent of the production was operated by PanCanadian and expected cash flow before general and administrative expenses was expected to be C$13.3 million annually.
Data room viewing was expected to start on January 6, PanCanadian said. ((-- Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
